articles.title: Coinbase's Jesse Pollak steps back from Base app leadership after admitting his crypto social strategy failed
articles.snippet: Pollak said that Jordan Fish, also known on X as 'Cobie,' will lead the Base app team.

articles.title: Trump to meet with senators over CLARITY Act on Thursday: Politico
articles.snippet: US President Donald Trump is set to meet with several senators on Thursday as negotiators race to get the CLARITY Act across the line before the Senate’s August recess.

articles.title: Base’s social bet left it trailing in prediction markets and perps: Pollak
articles.snippet: Base creator Jesse Pollak is stepping back from leadership of the Base App after admitting he was “definitively wrong” to bet on social experiences driving crypto adoption.

articles.title: Stanford study says 5-minute Bitcoin prediction markets enable settlement manipulation
articles.snippet: Researchers found that Polymarket’s five-minute Bitcoin prediction markets create incentives to manipulate spot prices around contract settlement, proposing longer settlement windows as a potential fix.

articles.title: Base Creator Jesse Pollak Steps Back From App Leadership After Admitting Social Bet 'Was Wrong'
articles.snippet: Pollak said he is handing the Base App back to Coinbase to focus on building Base into "the blockchain for global finance" after conceding the network's push into on-chain social missed the mark.
